decision.outcome: Local/windowed readout loses rank; the wrong-or-diffuse diagnosis routes to the diagnostic head (Decision 2.3) and re-planning.
decision.rule: at least half of high-error pairs correct-dominant-mode means windowing keeps rank; otherwise it loses rank

execution_scope.description: Descriptive one-seed replay over one object's correlated cyclic validation orbit; no inference and no pass/fail claim.

frozen_configuration.cell_error_unit: Euclidean normalized-coordinate error divided by 2/64, matching the representative pilot's CELL64_NORM
frozen_configuration.sample_unit: channel-frame pair over all validation frames
frozen_configuration.target_source: frame0_targets_px_in_channel_order in frozen config, transported by the pilot's roll target function

implementation_checks.correct_mode_distance: Euclidean distance in integer (x,y) heatmap-cell indices <= 1
implementation_checks.target_cell_quantization: nearest heatmap cell by numpy.rint; no half-cell tie occurred
implementation_checks.wrong_or_diffuse_definition: logical complement of correct-dominant-mode within the fixed global high-error denominator; v2.1 freezes no separate diffuse cutoff
